name: Entity Reference Field Autocomplete Filter
description: Create a field widget for entity reference fields that allows filtering by bundle.
project_description: Provides a single entity-reference field widget, 'Filterable Autocomplete' (plugin id entity_reference_filterable_autocomplete), that extends core's EntityReferenceAutocompleteWidget. When the reference field allows more than one target bundle, the widget adds a 'Search within' bundle select above the autocomplete textfield; picking a bundle restricts the autocomplete suggestions to that single bundle via an AJAX rebuild of the field's selection settings. With one or zero allowed bundles it behaves exactly like the core autocomplete widget. Set it per field on Manage form display. No dependencies beyond Drupal core, no permissions, no configuration form, no routes of its own.
